jobs.description:
On behalf of a partner company, Nordic Investin is looking for a Technical Delivery Lead Integration Platform. You create pace through clarity when workstreams, decisions and dependencies must move as one, and you surface risk early.
The partner is strengthening its capability in delivery leadership for shared integration and API capabilities. You will connect platform roadmap, delivery planning and architecture dependencies while ensuring that quality and stakeholder alignment receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
Project leadership connects outcomes, plans, risks and decisions. Success is controlled change the organisation can sustain.
How you will work
You will work across business, technology, suppliers and operations. The partner expects shared priorities, visible decisions and an adaptable delivery model.
This role calls for visible leadership and disciplined decision making. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for delivery leadership for shared integration and API capabilities.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for platform roadmap and delivery planning.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around architecture dependencies.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting quality.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve stakeholder alignment.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through service readiness.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering delivery leadership for shared integration and API capabilities in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of platform roadmap and delivery planning.
Practical experience applying architecture dependencies and quality.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving stakeholder alignment.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.
Experience that would add value
Experience from large enterprises and digital ecosystems.
Exposure to service readiness in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.
A background that can succeed here
Your background may be consulting, a transformation office or complex delivery. Show how you controlled uncertainty and guided difficult decisions. Direct experience of delivery leadership for shared integration and API capabilities is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.
What makes the opportunity interesting
The assignment offers visible responsibility, access to decision makers and room to shape a purposeful delivery model. The focus on delivery leadership for shared integration and API capabilities gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant programme, project or transformation you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.
